messages.subject: Instructions to advise - Bracken v Marldon (merits & quantum)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Harriet,

We should be grateful for your advice on merits and quantum in this TCC-track dispute. The papers (Particulars in draft, commissioning logs, failure register, Schedule of Loss and the enquiry data pack) will follow by courier. The two pressure points are (i) the reasonableness of Marldon's exclusion/limitation clauses under UCTA and (ii) remoteness of the £558k lost-production head.

A conference in the new year would be helpful.

Tom Gallagher

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ

messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Happy to advise. On first read the data-pack point looks decisive on liability. I'll want to see the membrane manufacturer's datasheet and the O&M manual on the maintenance allegation. I can do a conference week commencing 6 January. My written advice will follow by end of April once expert positions are clearer.

Harriet Stanford
Eldon Chambers
